mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.4% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.4%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent 1% monthly increases in housing starts and retail sales signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Weak industrial production growth below 0.5% annualized signals supply constraints, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as corporate profit margins face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 750,000 units indicate a contracting housing sector, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as consumer spending and economic activity weaken.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 750.0.

mechanism_narrative: High-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annualized growth > 2.5%) trigger expected monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized growth rate exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent payrolls growth and unemployment decline signal a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as consumer spending and earnings growth accelerate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production signals expanding economic output, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as supply conditions support corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases month-over-month.
